# Broadband Breakfast: AI Makes Fiber Operations Predictable


Kate Keith of Broadband Breakfast highlights how Michael Weening President and CEO of Calix sees practical AI as a way for services providers to turn growing volumes of network and customer data into more predictable business outcomes. Rather than focusing on AI for its own sake, Weening emphasizes using intelligent workflows to identify churn risks, uncover revenue opportunities, improve operational efficiency, and help providers deliver more personalized subscriber experiences.


[Read the full article on Broadband Breakfast](https://broadbandbreakfast.com/calix-ceo-sees-ai-as-key-to-making-fiber-operations-more-predictable)
